title: MSFS Marketplace: Carenado H125 Lands in 2020 + 737 Livery Deal!
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the storefront? Today, we break down a fascinating contrast in newly arrived airframes and packs on the MSFS Marketplace—ranging from single-engine rotary utility work to massive cost-saving airline fleet expansions.

To help you decide what fits your flight routine and budget, we inspect each arrival in detail:

- Microsoft & Carenado Airbus H125: The modern multi-role light utility workhorse helicopter officially makes its way into MSFS 2020. Developed in collaboration with Carenado, this single-engine rotorcraft features multiple operational configurations—from agricultural crop spraying gear to urban patrol setups—along with a wide selection of liveries. Note: this airframe requires a standalone purchase in MSFS 2020 even if you already have access to it in MSFS 2024.
- TwoPilot 737-8 Ultimate Liveries Bundle: A high-value airline bundle merging World Liveries 1 and 2 for the default 737 Max 8 into a single deeply discounted package. Slashed from roughly €12 down to just €3.39, it equips your fleet with real-world liveries including EgyptAir, flydubai, Virgin Australia, Lufthansa, Japan Airlines, Southwest, and more (requires base 737-8 ownership).

Whether you're practicing precision low-altitude utility flying in a proven turbine helicopter or dressing up your commercial airliner for line operations on a budget, we evaluate each release to help you decide what truly deserves a spot in your simulator installation.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below! Which of these add-ons are you picking up?
